description: This file defines the WPEFramework::PluginHost::Config class, which manages configuration settings for the plugin host, including nested classes for JSON configuration, environment variables, process settings, and path substitution logic. It also includes methods for updating network interface bindings, security, and plugin management.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for the plugin host, managing paths, network settings, plugins, and environment variables.

classes.name: Config::Substituter
classes.description: Handles variable substitution in configuration paths using delimiters and a lookup table.

classes.name: Config::JSONConfig
classes.description: Represents the JSON structure for configuration, including nested classes for environment variables, process settings, input configuration, and optional Hibernate and process container settings.

classes.name: Config::InputInfo
classes.description: Stores information about input device configuration, such as locator, type, and enabled status.

classes.name: Config::ProcessInfo
classes.description: Stores process-related configuration details like user, group, priority, policy, and umask.

methods.name: Config::UpdateBinder
methods.description: Updates network binding address based on interface configuration and sets the URL accordingly.

methods.name: Config::Security
methods.description: Sets the security interface for the configuration.
